# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/24068.
# When cgo is disabled and compilation fails, the go command should
# name the files that were excluded only because cgo is disabled.

env CGO_ENABLED=0

! go build ./needscgo
stderr 'undefined: add'
stderr '^note: cgo is disabled \(CGO_ENABLED=0\), so the build excluded .*cadd\.go, .*ctag\.go$'
! stderr 'ignored\.go'

! go test ./needscgo
stderr 'undefined: add'
stderr '^note: cgo is disabled \(CGO_ENABLED=0\), so the build excluded .*cadd\.go'

# Compile errors in packages without cgo files get no note.
! go build ./nocgo
stderr 'undefined: missing'
! stderr 'note:'

# Packages with cgo files that build without cgo print nothing extra.
go build ./fallback
! stderr .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27
-- needscgo/sum.go --
package needscgo

func Sum() int {
	if tagged {
		return add(1, 2)
	}
	return 0
}
-- needscgo/cadd.go --
package needscgo

// static int cadd(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
import "C"

func add(a, b int) int {
	return int(C.cadd(C.int(a), C.int(b)))
}
-- needscgo/ctag.go --
//go:build cgo

package needscgo

const tagged = true
-- needscgo/ignored.go --
//go:build ignore

package needscgo

import "C"
-- needscgo/sum_test.go --
package needscgo

import "testing"

func TestSum(t *testing.T) {
	if Sum() != 3 {
		t.Fatal("wrong sum")
	}
}
-- nocgo/nocgo.go --
package nocgo

var _ = missing
-- fallback/c.go --
package fallback

import "C"

func Value() int { return int(C.int(1)) }
-- fallback/nocgo.go --
//go:build !cgo

package fallback

func Value() int { return 1 }
